label: Открытый
description: A 10-sentence card for открытый, the past passive participle of открыть, with its short form открыт.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative long form. Открытый comes from the perfective открыть — the stem откры- plus the suffix -т- and an adjective ending. The long form agrees with masculine ящик.

missions.phrase: Открытая настежь дверь хлопала на ветру.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine nominative long form. The long participle takes -ая to agree with дверь. Открытая дверь equals дверь, которую открыли — the door that someone opened.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative long form. Открытое carries the neuter ending -ое to match окно. The -т- suffix marks the result — the window that had been opened.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative long form. The plural ending -ые lets открытые agree with двери as the opened doors of the shop.
Strategic focus: Feminine short form. The short predicative form открыта agrees only in feminine gender with дверь, with быть in the present understood. The door is open.

missions.phrase: Музей был открыт для всех гостей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine short form with быть. The short form открыт joins был to form a past passive: музей был открыт. It reports that the museum was open.
Strategic focus: Plural short form. The plural short form открыты agrees with окна and predicates the result with быть understood. The windows are all open.

missions.phrase: Я вижу широко открытую входную дверь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine accusative long form. With the object дверь the participle takes the accusative -ую, so открытую matches it in gender, number and case as the door that was opened.

missions.phrase: Свежий ветер дул из открытого окна.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Neuter genitive long form. Открытого takes the neuter genitive ending to agree with окна after из, marking the source — the window that was opened.

missions.phrase: Мы стоим у открытой настежь калитки.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine genitive long form. After у the noun калитки stands in the genitive, and открытой takes the matching feminine genitive ending to agree with it.
